forest fire lookout, timeless folkloric, rendered as watercolour concept art moodboard, high-contrast teal-and-orange, seamless paper sweep

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'forest fire lookout, timeless folkloric, rendered as watercolour'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Lighting reference: underlighting from a translucent base panel.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'forest fire lookout, timeless folkloric, rendered as watercolour'.

PANEL. This branch renders the full profile: strict 90-degree side view, silhouette-readable.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — raw board-formed concrete, fine sand and others — with their wear state, and grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
